system.name: OpenGWASDB
system.summary: Harmonised GWAS summary statistics, built into versioned Store Releases and queried by variant, Analysis or top hit.

people.name: Researcher
people.summary: Queries Store Releases by variant, Analysis or top hit, from R, Python or the CLI (MR, PheWAS, colocalisation).

people.name: Curator / operator
people.summary: Selects sources, maps traits, runs and approves builds, publishes Store Releases.

external.name: Summary-statistic sources
external.summary: GWAS Catalog (GWAS-SSF), FinnGen, OpenGWAS/UKB (GWAS-VCF), eQTLGen and pQTL (BESD), dbGaP MVP.

external.name: Reference panels
external.summary: LD Reference Panels (UKB, HGDP+1KGP), Ancestry Reference Panels and variant references (gnomAD).

external.name: Analysis tools
external.summary: ieugwasr, ieugwaspy, TwoSampleMR and local R/Python sessions.

external.name: GitHub
external.summary: Issues, the project board, CI, releases and the published project site (gh-pages).

containers.name: Engine (opengwasdb)
containers.summary: Reads sources, resolves Analyses, builds, validates, completes and queries Store Releases. Owns the store format.

containers.name: Store Registry
containers.summary: The accepted Release Bundle of every Store Release, its lineage and status.

containers.name: Manifest Generation
containers.summary: Source Inventory to candidate Release Bundle, through source connectors and curation.

containers.name: Release orchestration
containers.summary: Plans and runs the engine's argv for a Release Bundle, records each step, registers and publishes.

containers.name: Analysis Catalog
containers.summary: A generated, versioned database over every Release Bundle.

containers.name: Project site
containers.summary: Where OpenGWASDB stands; the stores, epics, trends and both repositories' docs.

containers.name: Store Releases
containers.summary: Built and Reference-Completed Store Releases (OGS-*), the format the engine writes and reads.

container_relations: selects sources and maps traits with
runs build, validate and complete through

stages.name: Acquire
stages.summary: Source Inventories, downloads and reference resources

stages.name: Generate
stages.summary: Manifest Generation and curation: a candidate Release Bundle

stages.name: Resolve
stages.summary: Analysis Resolution: one scan per Analysis, one Resolution Record

stages.name: Build
stages.summary: Store Release Build: layouts, encoding, variants

stages.name: Validate
stages.summary: Structural validation, source fidelity, the Observed-View Check

stages.name: Complete
stages.summary: Reference Completion against an LD Reference Panel

stages.name: Every stage
stages.summary: The store contract, the CLI and the project's own tooling

components.name: Source Readers
components.summary: The Source Reader seam and Column Maps; GWAS-SSF, GWAS-VCF, FinnGen and BESD readers.

components.name: Analysis Resolution
components.summary: One scan per Analysis to its Analytical Metadata and Resolution Record; row admission, INFO and SD.

components.name: Ancestry Assignment
components.summary: Assigned Ancestry from allele frequencies (NNLS mixture, admission gates) and store routing.

components.name: Variant Identity
components.summary: Canonical variant identity, orientation, rsids, the Store Variant Axis and liftover.

components.name: Dense Layout
components.summary: Dense Observed-Only builders (tabular and GWAS-VCF), top hits, Indexed Variant Subsets, Rho.

components.name: Ragged Layout
components.summary: Ragged builders (GWAS-SSF, BESD), Zarr CSR storage, the By-Variant Index and top hits.

components.name: Hybrid Layout
components.summary: One read per study, routed to the Dense Component or the Ragged Overflow Component; checkpointed.

components.name: Store Encoding
components.summary: The encoding plan, StoreCodec and decoded statistic planes (z, se, eaf, imputed).

components.name: Store Release envelope
components.summary: Paths, manifest, format versions, the array-creation seam, conversion, SQLite indexes.

components.name: Reference Completion
components.summary: The LD-block imputation kernel and the Dense, Ragged and Hybrid completion pipelines.

components.name: Validation
components.summary: Store validation, source fidelity, the EAF audit and the Observed-View Check.

components.name: Query
components.summary: The layout-independent query facade and result resolution.

components.name: Store contract model
components.summary: analyses.tsv, manifest and enum contracts; statistic helpers shared by builders, validators and queries.

components.name: Repair and re-encode
components.summary: Representation-only repairs and the SE re-encode of existing Store Releases.

components.name: Engine CLI
components.summary: The opengwasdb command line, the surface opengwasdb-stores and users call.

components.name: Source connectors
components.summary: One connector per Source Provider (GWAS Catalog, FinnGen, OpenGWAS, UKB-B, eQTLGen, dbGaP MVP).

components.name: Manifest Generation
components.summary: The one pipeline from a frozen Source Inventory to a candidate Release Bundle (ADR 0035, 0036).

components.name: Curation
components.summary: Trait Ontology Mapping, candidate review and promotion into the Canonical Trait Mapping Table.

components.name: Reference resources
components.summary: Builders for LD Reference Panels and other Reference Resources.

components.name: Release orchestration
components.summary: Release Bundle to engine argv, staged runs, registration and publication (ogstores).

components.name: Release Bundles
components.summary: The accepted Release Bundles and the master list of Store Releases.

components.name: Analysis Catalog
components.summary: A generated, versioned SQLite database over Release Bundles.

components.name: Project site
components.summary: Collectors, generated pages and the Quarto build of the project site.

components.name: Yardstick
components.summary: One fixed benchmark, recorded at the end of every epic.

components.name: Developer tools
components.summary: Benchmarks, spikes and repository checks.
